# Zenon design-system attribution

Theme CSS and the ZNN logo are from [digitalSloth/zenon-design-system](https://github.com/digitalSloth/zenon-design-system), commit `8d2f76d74a286bd722f1fb62f280d89740ca29a8`, downloaded 2026-10-04.

Original MIT license is retained in `LICENSE`. CSS is copied without modification. The source `tokens/fonts.css` imports Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono through Google Fonts; production will self-host licensed font binaries.

ZFT-specific composition, interactions, and sample artwork live outside this vendor directory. The NonFungible Cash homepage informed layout and product flow; its code and artwork were not copied.
